rv.q: This production is perfectly crafted to give you an unforgettable experience; both visually and audibly.
Ash Hunter was both sinister and sensational, his aura had the audience in suspense.

cn.t: Critics hail this Macbeth as mesmerizing and captivating, praising its modern twist on the classic tale. The immersive production impresses with striking visuals, including real mud and creative staging that refreshes Shakespeare's story for all audiences.
